standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.npc: Greetings! What can I do for you?

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.player: Hello there. What do you do around here?

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.npc: I'm a shipwright. I supply boats of all kinds to anyone with the money to afford them.

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.player: Interesting... Would I be able to buy one?

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.npc: Sorry, but I don't have any ready for sale right now. I'm sure I will soon, so keep checking back.

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.text: The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release-bu.npc: I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment. You'll have to come back later.

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release-bu.text: The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.
